title: finding(plugin-form,security): the tabbed, wizard and split object-form arms draw a field the user may not READ — only the default, drawer and modal arms call applyFieldPermissions
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named landing sites and a render probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` (class a) of the objectui#10475 dev report. The at-tier contract review of PR objectui#10556 checked it at source and left it out of scope. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

Field-level security gates what an object form DRAWS: a read-denied field is dropped, and a write-denied one is locked (`applyFieldPermissions`, `packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`). Only three of the six `ObjectForm` arms apply it:
- the default arm (`SimpleObjectForm`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, through `applyFieldPerms`);
- `DrawerForm`;
- `ModalForm`.

`TabbedForm`, `WizardForm` and `SplitForm` never call it. So under the same principal and the same section, those three arms draw a field the user may not read.

## Probe (the dev's, relayed; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

A scratch probe `probe-fls-arms` mounted the real `ObjectForm` at PR objectui#10556 head `6931629`: create mode, one section `['customer', 'amount']`, and a `MePermissionsProvider` denying read on `invoice.amount`.
- `simple` / `drawer` / `modal` drew `['customer']`.
- `tabbed` / `wizard` / `split` drew `['customer', 'amount']`.

Reviewer source read: `applyFieldPermissions` is imported only by `ObjectForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx` and `ModalForm.tsx`.

## Reach

Reachable on any object form authored with `formType: 'tabbed' | 'wizard' | 'split'` whose principal has a read-denied field. As with objectui#10433 and objectui#10434, this is defence in depth: ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` strips denied fields server-side, so the gap shows on a backend that does not strip. The form still draws an input, though, and the arms disagree with each other.

## Related, not the same defect

objectui#10563 (open): the same three arms never call `sanitizeFormData`, so an edit save writes the whole record. That card is about the WRITE set; this one is about what is DRAWN. They are the same family, and may share a fix seam.

## Dedupe

Semantic search of this repo, including closed issues:
- 「tabbed wizard split form arms draw a read-denied field applyFieldPermissions field-level security」 ⇒ 1 hit, objectui#10563 (above: related, not the same).
- Control, 「tabbed wizard split arms sanitizeFormData」 ⇒ objectui#10563, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `tabbed wizard split field-level security render` · `applyFieldPermissions TabbedForm WizardForm SplitForm` · `read-denied field drawn formType tabbed` · `FLS sectioned arms gap`
